title: Retain first locally observed pair after an owner-preserving native Enter
first_failed_transition: Closing native Enter clears the local tail, then the admitted observed-boundary settlement starts KnownStart without a retained separator. Existing first-word suffix tracking only handles UnknownStart; therefore next LEFT never receives an observed_first_word range and pair projection is refused despite selected APPLY.
decision: Reuse existing contiguous observed_suffix_chars for the first locally typed word when there is no retained boundary floor or first-word range, including KnownStart after Enter. Derive the same bounded first-word range only from independently observed append/backspace events and an actual retained closing separator. Keep completeness unchanged. Do not infer range from empty mirror or reconstructed word text.
reason: The installed predecessor corrects the first pair after fresh focus and with a preceding word, but refuses the same first pair after an owner-preserving Enter. That transition retains KnownStart while losing the independently observed closed-word range required by the existing pair projection. Extending the existing pending-range provenance repairs the first failed transition without changing completeness, candidate selection or delivery authority.
verification: The exact installed predecessor has a retained three-case Kitty physical baseline: 2 PASS and 1 FAIL after Enter. Two new regressions fail on previous production at None versus Some((0,5)); the successor passes 707 of 707 focused IME checks. Mandatory full source gates and installed physical successor evidence are pending.
not_tested: The successor is not installed at this decision checkpoint. Full release gates, successor native Kitty physical acceptance and universal client acceptance are not established by the focused source checks.

alternatives.design: Downgrade next word to UnknownStart after every Enter
alternatives.reason: Would change ordinary first-word correction authority although Enter is an independently observed boundary.

alternatives.design: Add a separate first-line counter, snapshot reader or output fallback
alternatives.reason: Existing WordScope suffix provenance already tracks precisely the required local input; additional retained authority and transports are unnecessary.

alternatives.design: Reuse suffix tracking while a first closed-word range is still pending
alternatives.reason: Preserves one owner and current token/frame/verifier contracts, no added fields or delivery change.

consequences.candidate_lattice_rank: No L1.1 generation/package/attestation, L2 retention, L3/L4/Bayes, joint mass or DecisionCore changes; no literal words or suffix rules in production.
consequences.false_authority: KnownStart remains KnownStart; observed counts never promote UnknownStart. First range requires positive independent local observed suffix length and a real retained separator with checked u8 offsets. A retained boundary or existing first range suppresses extra KnownStart tracking. Navigation, unproven input, reset and ownership changes retain existing revocation.
consequences.latency_tail: Constant integer/Option checks at existing callback settlement; no waits, queues, worker RPCs, deadline changes, allocations, new fields or timers. Existing <=24-byte WordLineage and callback budgets stay required.
consequences.cpu_rss: No model/build/runtime package size or per-key allocation change expected; remote guards and desktop physical checks remain bounded.
consequences.cache_identity: Existing WordLineage in tokens/frames carries counts and closes the range at the same boundary generation. All worker/cache/epoch/material checks remain unchanged.
consequences.package_reload: No fits, model copies, package schemas, delta reloads or service ownership changes.
consequences.learning: Only existing confirmed visible result semantics; any inverse rejection uses original exact owned cleanup.
consequences.concurrency: Counts derive from exact append/right-backspace observations only. Unknown old callbacks cannot grant range; existing transfer/word token equality and stale-result invalidation remain authoritative.
consequences.compatibility: All native terminal, GTK surrounding/preedit, atomic and daemon output routes untouched. UnknownStart manual suffix, Tab, first-word correction and modifier contracts must remain green.
consequences.failure_rollback: Retain baseline FAIL and new-test RED evidence; reject if any required full gate or affected physical contour fails. Restore exact accepted b59 IME artifact if installed successor fails, without global IBus restart or input-source migration.
consequences.maintenance: One existing provenance counter and predicate, no new source of truth; update existing first-word proof tests and owning document.

proof_denominators.physical: same three fresh native cases, repeated Enter boundaries, original safety revocations and original installed route probes; bounded results separate from universal acceptance
